description: Discover the SCRIPTMASTERLABS x402 Gateway contract (FREE, read-only). Returns the gateway's job, transport, and canonical payment contract — x402 v2, exact scheme, USDC on Base mainnet (eip155:8453), the canonical payTo, and the PAYMENT-REQUIRED / PAYMENT-SIGNATURE / PAYMENT-RESPONSE headers — plus where to inspect fresh per-route payment requirements before calling a paid route (tools/list on this endpoint, or GET /x402/discover). The gateway never spends for the caller: read the fresh target 402 challenge for the exact price and terms; a challenge or a signature is not settlement proof.
name: sml_discover
title: Discover SML x402 Gateway
